tool_args.rationale: The open-branch observation supports a gradient-dependent reduction, but the sparse, confounded pilot still leaves competing response and interaction laws plausible. A trajectory batch can provide additional variation before committing to a numerical fit.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a stationary concave response with a gradient-dependent sink
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Six observations with jointly varying substrate and gradient do not identify the sink interaction or distinguish plausible nonlinear branches.
The previously acquired open-branch point already supplies that intervention; repeating it may not resolve the remaining ambiguity.
It is irrelevant to identifying the response law.
